title: Artificial Intelligence Researcher
job_description: Overview We are looking for an AI Researcher to join the R&D team to build practical AI and machine learning solutions for real-world analytical problems. This role focuses on statistical modelling, predictive analytics, LLM-powered AI agents, and intelligent systems that work across structured and unstructured data. Fresh graduates with strong AI fundamentals and hands-on project experience are encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Research & Data Analysis Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and identify meaningful trends and patterns from datasets. Develop predictive and statistical models including regression, classification, and forecasting models. Conduct hypothesis testing, significance testing, and model validation. AI & LLM Development Design and develop AI agents powered by LLMs to automate analytical workflows. Build systems that integrate LLMs with databases, predictive models, and external tools. Evaluate AI agent performance including reasoning quality, hallucination handling, and task completion. Technical Development Develop clean and scalable Python code for machine learning and data processing pipelines. Work with SQL databases and structured datasets. Contribute to reproducible AI workflows, experiment tracking, and shared codebases. Essential Technical Skills Strong Python programming skills with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, SciPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn. Hands-on experience in machine learning, statistical modelling, and predictive analytics. Experience with data wrangling, feature engineering, missing data handling, and structured datasets. Good understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and generative AI models. Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, RAG, LangChain, vector databases, or GenAI frameworks is advantageous. Strong mathematical foundations in statistics, linear algebra, calculus, and optimisation. Singaporean ONLY
